blocks.html: In partnership with Robinsons Malls, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) will launch the Temporary Off-Site Passport Services “TOPS” this July for the public. Applicants are advised to set an appointment through the DFA Online Appointment System (OAS) on www.passport.gov.ph or through the QR Code below. Applicants without fully accomplished printed appointments shall not be accepted in the passport processing site.
Applicants may visit the following Robinsons sites:

items: Robinsons Place Las Pinas, Level 2, near Food Court (from July 7 to September 30, Mondays to Saturdays, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm); and
Robinsons Magnolia, Level 4, New Wing near Admin. office (from July 7 to September 30, Mondays to Fridays, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm).

blocks.html: The DFA and Robinsons Malls partnership is under the Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy where every Filipino has convenient access to government agencies nationwide. Since it was established in 2010, Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy has served millions of Filipinos with their government requirements to include NBI, SSS, Phil Health, Pag Ibig, PRC, PSA, LTO, GSIS and SEC.
